hidden_risks: Whether the actual item is functional and heats properly
Physical condition, scratches, or rust on the real unit
Completeness of internal shelves and electrical components
response.best_proof: A real photo of the actual item showing power on and physical condition
response.drop_reason: The photo is a stock or catalogue image, not the seller's actual item.
response.failure_mode: AI might judge the condition based on a pristine stock photo and fail to recognize that the listing uses a generic catalogue picture instead of the actual item for sale.
